question: A Pan-India band performances on the theme ‘Vande Mataram’ were organised from January 19 to 26, 2026 by the Indian Army, Indian Navy, Indian Air Force, Indian Coast Guard, and other CAPFs. The performance venues also included the ancestral home and birthplace of which historical personality in North 24 Parganas District, West Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rishi Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Pan-India band performances on the theme ‘Vande Mataram’ **were organised** from January 19 to 26, 2026, by the Indian Armed Forces and CAPFs, with venues including the ancestral home of **Rishi Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The performance venues included the ancestral home and birthplace of Rishi Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay located at Kanthalpara, Naihati, in the North 24 Parganas District of West Bengal.**
 
• The site, presently known as ‘Bankim Bhawan Gaveshana Kendra’ (also referred to as Rishi Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay’s Residence and Museum or Bankim Sangrahashala), **was selected** for these significant performances.
 
• These events **were conducted** by the Indian Army, Indian Navy, Indian Air Force, Indian Coast Guard, and other CAPFs as part of the Republic Day 2026 celebrations.
 
• The performances **were scheduled** between January 19 and January 26, 2026, to celebrate the theme of ‘150 years of Vande Mataram’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Theme Context**__

 __
 
• The Republic Day 2026 celebrations **were centered** around the theme ‘150 years of Vande Mataram’.
 
• Paintings by Shri Tejendra Kumar Mitra from 1923 illustrating verses of the song **were displayed** as view-cutters along Kartavya Path.
 
 
 
• **Other Celebrations**__
 __
 
• Floral decorations in front of the rostrum **were executed** based on the Vande Mataram theme.
 
• A banner depicting ‘Vande Mataram’ **was unveiled** along with the release of rubber balloons at the conclusion of the parade.
 
 
 
• **Chief Guests**__
 
 
• President of the European Council Mr. Antonio Costa and President of the European Commission Ursula von der Leyen **were invited** as the Chief Guests.
